rows.TEXT: You'll be cutting a swathe through the land in no time.
I think my magical library can be of some help to you.
My spells can help you in your quest.
I will train your units for a price.
Crrraaack! Oh my! Was it your neck that just snapped?
How may I help you stranger?
I will train your units for a price.
Are you in need of recruits?
Everything I possess is for sale.
My wares can help you in your quest.
Everything I possess is for sale.
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, she is known for her intensity in battle and her courage in the face of overwhelming odds. She once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.

Illumielle 
"I must tell you the story of the Angel Falls. Sometime ago an Arch-Angel was traveling when a minion of Mortis attacked her. The vile creature viciously assaulted the Arch-Angel. Before taking her final breathes she made one last effort."

Illumiele 
"The Arch-Angel's last will and testament was to bless the waterfalls. So that anyone traveling the road that she took could hopefully avoid the same fate. These waters will heal the weak and the injured. Use these waters wisely."

Envoy Angus 
"I must remind you that we have to free the Dark Elves. I know that Mortis has twisted them into her own image. We cannot turn our backs on them. Gallean wants us to liberate them and that is all I need to know.  Nothing else matters."

"We must proceed with caution. We are going further into the Mountain Clans territory. Despite our treaty both sides have caused enough misery for the other. Proceed with caution, there will always be one angry group who does not like the treaty."

"As tempting as it is to just take everything we must respect the treaty. Finding the Dark Elves and returning them to the light is our mission. Only by saving our fellow Elves will we be able to build a stronger Alliance!"

Loremaster Lantfrid 
"How dare you! I do not care what a piece of paper states! The Elven Alliance are a disgrace. I shall avenge all those who have fallen!"

Envoy  Angus 
"The Loremaster's words have a ring of truth. The Mountain Clans will never fully trust us, nor I them! I will not allow the Mountain Clans to stop our mission to free Gallean's Elves. I hope that we can have peace if not so be it."

Lich Queen 
"Oh the mighty Elves stand before this dark tower. Mortis knows of your plans and it shall not be easy to win over the Dark Elves. Oh no, they shall belong to Mortis ever more. Leave this place! Now or suffer!"

Lich Queen 
"How I love Mortis! You have already destroyed some Elves. You wish to save the Dark Elves and then you are forced to defeat them. Now in the name of Mortis I shall defeat all those who defy her!"
"This tower before us is said to have plenty of gold. There is a curse upon the tower! That whoever goes into the tower will unleash a dragon upon the land!"

Lich Queen 
"Death follows you everywhere! Mortis shall claim all of your souls! The Elven Alliance shall become Mortis's Alliance!"

Illumielle 
"The Mountain Clans are sending for more reinforcements. I do not know what will transpire. We must keep an eye on them at all times. They are not to be trusted, whether we have a treaty with them or not!"

Elder One 
"We have declared that the Elven Alliance have a hidden agenda. This land belongs to the Mountain Clans. All those who set foot on this ground are declared enemies! Death will be swift and you can join Mortis in the afterlife!"

"Look at the land and wealth around us! Everything off of our island belongs to the Mountain Clans. All the resources and wealth can never be ours. Still I suppose in order to have peace we need to make sacrifices."

Engineer 
"Halt! The Elves are not allowed to pass through. Aside from the fact that your presence personally disgusts me, I do not believe that the Mountain Clans are comfortable with your presence here. This is a special place to celebrate Wotan!"

"The Empire are having trouble within their own ranks. An Imperial Priest has declared that the Empire has lost its way. In response the Priest has formed a rebellion and his own Imperial Empire. Are treaty is not recognized by these militants!"

Imperial Archmage Renard 
"Right you are! The Imperial Empire sees you as an enemy. All those who side with the Empire are our foes. However do not feel too badly, we don't care for Elves either!"

Pegasus Knight Goar 
"The Elves are not welcomed here. We know of your dealings with the Empire. Sadly we cannot afford to extend an act of non-aggression. I will find your defeat amusing."

Duke  
"Little Elves, we find ourselves in a position to aid one another. I cannot get free from my city, while you on the other hand cannot get to the Empire. I am willing to make a deal with you."

Duke 
"Over by the Imperial City known simply as the High Father's River is a key. Bring this iron key to me and in return I will allow the gates that block your way to the Empire to vanish."

"Before you think that you can defeat me. I would not advise a confrontation, for only I can make those gates vanish. So it is in your best interest to bring me the key. For if I shall fall so does all hope in opening the gate. Now go!"
"Foul creature! I have done what you have asked me to do. I bring to you the iron key. Now live up to your end of the bargain swine!"

Duke 
"Very well, I shall live up to my end of the bargain. Behold the gateway will vanish. Little Elf, I fear that you have received more than you have bargained for!"

Arch-Devil 
"Behold the Legions Of The Damned! Should you fall before my might, thousands from the fiery pits shall emerge upon this realm!"
"These water falls seem to have mystical powers. We can heal our weak and wounded underneath these waterfalls."

Imperial Ranger Rollon 
"Don't be such a fool. You have worked long and hard to get to this point. Do not dare enter here. This city is protected by the Imperial Mages. Lightning shall strike you down. Even someone as mighty will fail! Now leave!"
"Foul creature! They dare to attack the Elven Alliance! We will send them all back to the fiery depths from which they came!"

Duke 
"The Legions Of The Damned have underestimated your power! We will not do that again. Next time we meet we shall burn your cities to the ground and defeat your guardian!"

"Foul creatures! They dare stand in our way and spoil this great city! Gallean will not be pleased to know that Orcs and Ogres have occupied his great city! Knowing these creatures as I do, there must be more on their way!"

Illumielle 
"There is great magic in these water falls. The Arch-Angels that have died in these falls have left their magic behind. I fear though that the magic will not after the fifteenth day! Use it wisely while you can."

Hermit 
"A treaty is a treaty! As much as I personally do not like the Elves, I will follow the orders of Wotan. My Elven friend, I must warn you. Do not think about stealing our gold. This belongs to the Mountain Clans as does most of this land!"

"The word of Gallean has declared that the twin cities must not be occupied by anyone other than Elves. The Orcs and have others have invaded these cities too often. To gain Gallean's good graces we must liberate the cities, Skylark and Gryffin."
"The cities are once again ours! We must never lose these cities to outside forces. If so I fear that Gallean will punish us most severely!"

"We must proceed with caution. This tower is the home of a group of Primitive Giants. Rarely have these Giants been seen. For good reason they enrage easily. We do not need to be drawn into a battle. We must free the Dark Elves from Mortis."
"The signs of the Undead Hordes are everywhere. There may be a way yet to find a new path that will lead us to Mortis and her Undead realm!"

Illumielle 
"Stay clear from there! I have sensed that a great evil will be unleashed upon you should you stay any longer. Leave now while you still can!"

"The Winter Dragon Tower is legendary! There are stories that the three white dragons residing within are unstoppable. The tower is home to a large amount of gold. A King's ransom in gold awaits us. We can use this gold and put it towards are campaign."

Illumielle 
"Brave warrior, Gallean smiles upon those who endure great battles in his name. With your victory our Lord will reward you. Go and defeat these dragons. For the glory of the Mountain Clans defeat these vile beasts!"

"I have heard that the demonic creature can give us the power to topple Mortis and free the Dark Elves from the grasp of the Undead. By dealing with this creature we risk further slipping into the madness that surrounds Mortis!"

Onyx Gargoyle 
"Foolish Elf! Do not waste your time contemplating moral choices. In this realm right and wrong do not exist! Power exists, power and nothing more! Join me, and I will tell you the secrets of infinite power!"

Illumielle 
"What are you doing! Do not listen to that demonic creature! I know of him. He is bound to that island for an eternity. I have heard that he made a deal with Bethrezen. He gave the secrets to acquiring infinite power. At a cost!"

Illumielle 
"Though he claims to know the secret! Bethrezen made sure that he can never share that secret. He shall forever remain on the island. The moment that he leaves his prison all knowledge given to him will be lost. He will forget everything!"

Onyx Gargoyle 
"Aaaaarrrrrrrgggghhhhhh! Curse you! I am bound to this island for I do not wish to forget the path to infinite power! On this island I am supreme, I am not like any ordinary Onyx Gargoyle. Face me and suffer at the hands of my might!"
"We are in dangerous waters in an evil realm! Only caution can prepare us for the horrors that we are bound to confront!"

"This Tower was built dedicated to the power of Gallean. Those who dwell within are more powerful than they otherwise would appear. Their presence is a danger to the Alliance. We are Galleans favorite and it should remain that way!"

Forest Liege  
"This land will be ours! We will make a tribute to Gallean and we will free the Dark Elves from Mortis! You have failed, the Alliance cannot defeat Mortis, we can. We are ruthless as you are about to find out!"

"The evil creature has been vanguished by our might! Now we must make our way to the Empire. Only they have what we will need to find and defeat the Undead Hordes! For Gallean we will find the Dark Elves and bring them back to his light!"

Death Knight 
"The Elvesssss, will fail for Gallean searches not for the Dark Elves. He yearns for Mortissss! Join the Undead Hordes leave the Alliance behind! Death stalks you as we speak! I shall send you to Mortis myself!"
"This is not good. The Hermit's passing will not go unnoticed by the Mountain Clans. Our hand was forced! The peace must last, if we are going to save the Dark Elves! This is not good!"

Envoy Angus 
"This is unsettling! However he was alone and I do not believe the Mountain Clans will know anytime soon. I do not plan on telling them, anyone else?"

Illumielle 
"I have been placed in a difficult situation! The treaty must stand at all cost. The Mountain Clans are powerful and they own much of the resources. If anyone should ask about this hermit's passing. We will not volunteer any information!"

Guardian Ellamend 
"What of his family, they will surely seek out the truth. If we come across anyone from the Mountain Clans must we lie? We are noble creatures and we live up to a higher code of ethics than most."

Envoy Angus 
"My friend, there is not a person who shares your grief more so that I. For I hear Gallean's call. With a heavy heart I must tell you that this is for a greater purpose that exceeds this poor unfortunate soul."

Forest Liege Savary 
"Thank Gallean! I thought that I was going to rot in that dungeon. My abductors tortured me! There isn't a soul that likes or truly trusts Gallean. Since his return the other powers have been nervous about Gallean's presence!"

Forest Liege Savary 
"While in the dungeon, I thought I was going mad! I heard a Demon saying that everything is going according to plan. I overheard the creature say that a war to eradicate the Elves is on its way. I will serve you until I die!"

The Imperial Palace, once home to the most powerful Mage Lords in the Empire. The city is a shadow of its former self. A great warrior of the Elves has been captured and tortured by the current owners! Free him and he shall loyally aid us in our Quest!"

Envoy Angus 
"I salute you Queen Illumielle! I bring you greetings from our God Gallean. I have been chosen to speak for him. Our Lord is displeased. There have been great wrongs done to him and he wishes to be avenged!"

Illumielle 
"What great wrong has been acted upon our powerful Lord. Why should the Elves unite and march to war? I assure you that I am peaceful Queen and war is not a path taken to easily. Only when all else fails do we somberly march to war."

Envoy Angus 
"I too share your views. However I am nothing more than the voice of the spirit that binds us. Gallean is angry over the Dark Elves. The desecration of the soul of our ancient heroes warped into these abominations must be amended!"

Oracle Elf 
"How can you be so sure that this is Gallean's will? The visions that I have are not clear. The only thing that is certain is that the wrath of Gallean increases with each passing day."

Envoy Angus 
"I have been chosed by Gallean to help the Elves and bring them on the right path. Our Lord has made me his voice and I speak for him. Tomorrow you will learn more as others arrive."

Envoy Angus 
"I have not come alone others fight by my side. They shall aid me wherever I go. As I pledge to lead Gallean's call they too shall fight along our side. Agothorne and Arcillen join us and tomorrow others will come."

Centaur 
"My Queen, Elves from the Southern forests have arrived."

Guardian Ellamend 
"I have heard his call. Gallean calls out to us. We will serve the Alliance to answer Gallean's calling!"

Illumielle 
"It would appear that Envoy Angus's words ring true. Others have heard the calling. So Envoy, will you then tell us exactly what it is that Gallean expects from us?"

Envoy Angus 
"We must assist Gallean in freeing the Dark Elves from the clutches of Mortis and put an end to this travesty. We first shall travel south where we can find sufficient resources and set up a camp to attack from.

Guardian Ellamend 
"This implies going through the Mountain Clans territory! Elves and Clans have had a peaceful relationship. Despite this peace, I don't think they will allow a group bent on war through their homeland."

Oracle 
"I know that we have worked hard for this peace with the Mountain Clans. I am sure it shall be worked out. I am more concerned over Gallean's growing anger. He is not fond of our hesitations and we should follow Envoy Angus. "

Illumielle 
"So it has been declared. We shall follow the word of Gallean. Let nothing stop us from freeing the Dark Elves from the tyranny of the Undead Hordes."

Guardian Ellamend 
"More arrive! They shall pledge their allegiance to this great cause!"

Envoy Angus 
"We are the elite from the Elven Alliance! We request to passage through your lands as we have business beyond your lands. I, Gallean's envoy who represents our Lord would like a word with your leader."

Dwarf King 
"What have we here forest dweller. What would you be doing at my doorstep with arms and spells ready?"

Envoy Angus 
"We seek passage through your land. For we are sent on a holy mission by Gallean!"

Dwarf King 
"Despite our treaty I cannot let war ready combatants into my back yard. A war ready party sharing our borders creates enough unease. I will not allow it, turn around and leave peacefully."

Envoy Angus 
"I only asked you out of formality. I listen and obey Gallean! My I knew that  you would show the reason of a hibernating bear. Sleeping while the world still turns. Elves to arms! War to the Clans and death to any who get in our way!"

Guardian Ellamend 
"Have you gone mad! The Dwarf King was just being careful. He would have let us pass with more diplomacy! This is not the way!"

Envoy Angus 
"Time is a commodity that we are losing with each passing moment! Be at peace with your troubled spirit. This is the word of Gallean and his word is greater than all of our spirits."

Illumielle 
"How dare you declare war! Do you realize that you have destroyed a treaty that many have died to make possible? How can you do this without consulting me first!"

Envoy Angus 
"I wish to pass through your lands! I am the voice of Gallean he speaks to me. As I stand before you he whispers into my ear. My party and I have business to attend to and we wish to ask you for safe passage."

Rock Giant Votan 
"Little Elf, I have heard your request and I cannot allow you passage. Despite our recent agreement to a cease fire. Many dwarves are uneasy about the Elven Alliance. I cannot let a war bent party pass through our borders."

Envoy Angus 
"Do you not hear me! I said that Gallean speaks to me, I can hear him screaming for me to walk right by you. Your ill placed fool's pride will not stop our holy war! So speaks Gallean!"

Envoy Angus 
"Elves! I command that you prepare yourselves for battle. The Mountain Clans wish for us to defy Gallean. I say to you foolish Mountain Fools that you have brought this upon yourselves. In the name of Gallean I declare war!"

Dwarf King 
"The Elven Alliance must be destroyed. We will not allow some forest dwelling rats dictate us!"

Envoy Angus 
These cities must be conquered. We must secure the region and gather as much resources as possible!"

Guardian Ellamend 
"What madness is this? Are we to attack the Empire colonies as well? Surely Gallean has no plan for us to kill innocent people?"

Envoy Angus 
"I hear him calling to me. I can hear the voice can't you? This is Gallean's will! We will need the resources for the tasks ahead. This battle with the Mountain Clans will be costly. We do not have a choice! We will do what is necessary!"

Oracle Elf 
"He speaks the truth! I can sense that Gallean is angry. He wants the Dark Elves to be freed from the evil that shapes them. We must do this or we shall displease our Lord! Take the Empire's capital!"

"Galleans Fifth Column are here! This self styled secret society claim to be the Gallean's hand of vengeance! Our paths differ at the moment, our only goal is the save the Dark Elves. Though I hesitate to do this, if they get in our way slaughter them!"

Illumielle 
"Have you lost your sense? We are becoming nothing more than a band of murdering barbarians. Attack only in self defense. Galleans Fifth Column are still fellow Elves."

"I can feel this impulse in me growing. This must be Gallean's will acting upon us. That city to the south. We must conquer it and destroy everyone that resides within. Only this way we can destroy the gates that stop us from our goal!"

Illumielle 
"This change has become unsettling! I do not approve! Despite the love that I have for our Lord Gallean. This cannot go on. You will not attack that city. Despite our differences with the Imperials or anyone else."

Oracle Elf 
"My Queen, I know that the Empire and the Alliance have agreed to a treaty based on the Alliance not intervening in the Empire-Imperial war. Our needs are greater than a treaty. This is Gallean's will and he angers!"

Oracle Elf 
"See my Queen, Gallean is displeased with our hesitation. If we do not do as he says who knows what wrath shall befall us!"

Illumielle 
"Very well! Gorgon Castle must falll in the name of Gallean. Despite my displeasure we are nothing more than subjects of Gallean."

"We must take all of the cities in the region including the capital. The Empire must fall to our hand! Nothing call stop us now! Gallean's calling must be answered with a path of blood. We will go through the Empire to get to the Undead Hordes!"

Illumielle 
"This is not the way! Gallean can want blood all he wants this cannot happen! Our people will not become a group of murdering bandits! I order you to stop! This blood lust has spread through the Alliance and it cannot go on!"

Oracle Elf 
"My Queen you must watch what you say. Gallean's anger grows and he is not pleased with what he has heard. We have little choice. For the Elven Alliance to survive this Empire settlement must die! I wish there was another way!"

Illumielle 
"Then we do not have a choice. If our Lord wishes it to be done then we have little choice. Let those that perish on this day be in the name of Gallean and not the Elven Alliance. With a heavy heart I ask you to follow Gallean's wishes!"

Oracle Elf 
"Gallean is not all about vengeance! The Elven Alliance will be rewarded by him if all we do is listen and do as we are told. We shall be spared his anger!"

Forest Liege 
"Gallean wishes for us to destory everyone in this realm! I can hear him calling to me. We are to defeat the Imperials that we encounter and we shall be rewarded. We will toss them into the river and be on our way."

Guardian Ellamend 
"This cannot be right! How can we have become so low! I cannot support such blood thirsty passion. What have the Elves become?"

Illumielle 
"What has happened I do regret! However, we have defeated many Imperials and we must make our way to the Empire capital to salvage what peace treaty we have left."

Guardian Ellamend 
"Then to the Empire we must go and make sure that we have a lasting peace. We do not want to be drawn into a war while fighting the Mountain Clans!"

Guardian Ellamend 
"Envoy Angus! You and I shall have words should we survive this assault upon the Empire. You have caused much misery and death. I will see to it that you answer for your crimes!"

Envoy Angus 
"Spare me your threats! The Elves of the Southern Forest have angered Gallean for ages. I have been picked to answer his calling and I do not fear you or anyone. I am the voice of reason, I am the voice of Gallean. You will do as I say!"

Illumielle 
"I will not have the two of you at each other's throats. With war declared upon the Empire we have little choice but to defeat them. Should we fail the Empire will burn our houses down and imprison our people!"

Envoy Angus 
"Silence false Queen. You do not reign over me! I have heard the voice of the all mighty Gallean and we shall do as we are told! Gallean rewards the loyal and punishes those who hesitate! Now let us burn the Empire! Death to the Empire!"

Envoy Angus 
"The precious Queen of the Alliance will be punished. Gallean is not pleased with her questions and her defiance. Your punishment my dear is forthcoming. Gallean will erode your power until you are too weak to defend yourself!"

Envoy Angus 
"Your presence on the Elven Alliance disgusts me. I cannot wait until Gallean strikes down upon you! I refuse to fight alongside the Alliance any longer! If Gallean does not strike you down then I shall sacrifice you myself!"

Envoy Angus 
"Your rule Illumielle will come to its end by my blade! You are not worthy to serve Gallean. Only I am and those who follow me! Gallean's word is law and I am his sword!"

Arch-Angel 
"I come with a message from my King. He declares that your actions will bring a monumental war that can lost for ages if you do not return to your forest at once."

Envoy Angus 
"Those are big words from such a feeble King. I take orders from one being and it is not your foolish King. Gallean commands that your capital is to fall. So it shall come to pass! I declare war on the Empire!"

Guardian Ellamend  
"How dare you! How could we have stooped so low so quickly? I will not have any of this!"

Peasant 
"They Elves are here, the Elves are here!"

Envoy Angus 
"Let's have some fun and sacrifice the peasants to Gallean! I am sure that our Lord will reward us for their eradication!"

Guardian Ellamend 
"How dare you suggest such a thing. That is nothing to make light of. These are innocent peasants trying to provide for themselves."

Envoy Angus 
"Suggest, that was not a suggestion. That is an order from the all mighty Gallean. I can hear the calling. I hear him at night and when I am awake I can hear his voice. He screams that we must sacrifice the peasants! Do it now!"

Envoy Angus 
"Let Gallean feast upon the souls that we have sacrificed to him. Gallean I call out to you! Are you not pleased for what we have done! Show these nay sayers a sign. Show them that I speak for you!"

Envoy Angus 
"Ha! Ha! Gallean is pleased for what we have done on this day! The humble little peasants are just a sample of what is to come. The Empire must fall in this realm so that we may continue our holy war! The Dark Elves shall be freed!"

"We have been rewarded by our great spirit. Gallean will preserve us! I can almost feel as though he has given me this himself! I cannot wait for the day that we break Mortis's grasp upon our fellow Elves!"
"The people are terrified! As they should be we will rule them with an iron fist. I have never liked the Mountain Clans!"

Illumielle 
"Do not waste time! I care not for this war, however Gallean commands us! Nearby there is a waterfall. Look to see  if these waterfalls are enchanted. If so, use it wisely!"
"Look through the prisons! Let us see who we have freed from this castle."

Gindelwys 
"Finally someone has come to end my torment. I sat in the dungeon and I can hear and sense Gallean. He is angry with each passing day his anger grows. I can hear him  whispering in my ear. I dare not disobey. I shall fight with you!"

Envoy Angus 
"We must kill everyone that stands in our way!" I can hear Gallean reaching out to us. I can hear his frustrations! We must defeat the Empire so that many of Galleans' children may live!"

Oracle Elf 
"Gallean  is angry! I am in great pain! I am being punished by Gallean! I must instruct you that a great servant will aid us! She is held captive in one of the three cities near the Empire's capital. Release her, and she will be loyal!"

Illumielle 
"I have a message for all of those who have recently joined us. With the exception of Angus, none of you shall be following us after we meet the Empire."

Envoy Angus 
"My dearest apologies Illumielle, I question the wisdom of your decision. Gallean will require that all the Elves fight and die in his name!"

Illumielle 
"Envoy Angus, I thank you for your input. However if you are to serve the Alliance you will understand that my word is law! I have my reasons and I will not be questioned by you or anyone!"

Envoy Angus 
"Again, I have to point out that you are not making any sense. I am Envoy Angus privileged to hear the words of Gallean. I accept your decision though I do not care for it myself."
